name: Generalized Differentiable Renderer (GenDR)
definition: A generalized differentiable mesh renderer that models the forward rendering process under a probabilistic perturbation defined by a probability distribution with density f and a temperature/scale parameter τ > 0, making the renderer continuous everywhere and differentiable almost everywhere.
summary: GenDR is a generalized differentiable mesh renderer that models forward rendering under probabilistic perturbation, enabling continuous gradients for optimization by aggregating face contributions via sigmoid functions and T-conorms.
